limitations: Underlying ticks are exact API data; they are shared market data, not separate Demo/Real price histories.
DERIV_API_TOKEN_REAL is required for real-account proposal quotes; without it, no Real API quote is claimed.
Historical proposal/bid/commission snapshots are not available from ticks_history. The simulator uses current API proposal quotes plus deterministic contract formulas.
No random sampling or Monte Carlo is used. Stop-out is modeled at the documented multiplier stop-out level with a loss capped at stake.
A held winner is marked at the final historical tick; this is unrealized and not a realized withdrawal.
This is a deterministic path simulation, not proof that the same path or quote will repeat in the future.
